description.value: On Xofirth, you're one of the smallest sentient life-forms, and you've had to develop techniques to avoid much larger predators in a variety of situations. You become trained in Athletics or Survival. If you're already trained in both of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Choose one kind of terrain from the following list: muddy, rocky, sandy, sloped, undergrowth. You ignore difficult terrain or uneven ground of that type.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
